source.title: Brandon (anime) - Bulbapedia, the community-driven Pokémon encyclopedia

result.summary: This article is a Bulbapedia encyclopedic entry covering Brandon, the chief Frontier Brain and Pyramid King of the Battle Pyramid in the Pokémon anime. It documents his background, battle history against Ash Ketchum and Paul, known Pokémon team members, manga presence, and voice acting credits.
limitations: The source is a wiki text article rather than video footage, so exact visual timestamps, camera framings, audio tracks, and full line-by-line dialogue transcripts are not present.
The article does not record full competitive build details (such as natures, abilities, EVs, IVs, levels, or held items) for Brandon's Pokémon.
The outcome of Paul's eventual rematch against Brandon at Snowpoint Temple is noted as unknown.

lore.subject: Brandon
lore.fact: Brandon is the Frontier Brain and chief of the Battle Frontier's Battle Pyramid, awarding the Brave Symbol to Trainers who defeat him.

lore.subject: Brandon
lore.fact: Brandon is the strongest of all Frontier Brains and the first Trainer in the animated series to have officially caught and trained a Legendary Pokémon.

lore.subject: Reggie and Paul
lore.fact: Brandon defeated Reggie in battle, prompting Reggie to retire from competitive battling to become a Pokémon Breeder, and inspiring Paul's obsession with strength.

lore.subject: Battle Pyramid Location
lore.fact: Trainers could only discover the location of the Battle Pyramid after acquiring the other six Frontier Symbols.
lore.at: In animation > History > Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire

lore.subject: Battle Frontier Hall of Fame
lore.fact: Defeating Brandon earned Ash a place in the Frontier Battle Hall of Fame and an offer to become a Frontier Brain, which Ash declined.
lore.at: In animation > History > Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire

lore.subject: Regigigas and Snowpoint Temple
lore.fact: Centuries ago, Regigigas saved Snowpoint City from a volcanic eruption before going to sleep sealed inside Snowpoint Temple.

creatorClaims: The fact that trainers only learned the Battle Pyramid's location after obtaining six symbols 'suggests that Brandon ranked higher than the rest of the Frontier Brains in Pokémon the Series, although in the video games and manga, this position belongs to Anabel.'
